description: An older man with grey hair in a white lab coat stands behind a dark wooden counter, holding a white pill bottle. A small green-and-white capsule lies on the counter. A dark-sleeved arm reaches in from the left toward the bottle. The background has shelves of amber bottles, a beige CRT monitor with a keyboard, and stacked papers. It is an oil-painting style, cropped edge to edge, with no visible text.
